tex_content.html:
Proposition
[Lie derivative of a vector field is the bracket]

Source: petersen:page-0061, petersen:page-0062 ↗ def:pet-ch2-lie-derivative-vector-field

1. ch2:2.1.1If $X,Y$ are vector fields on $M$, then $L_XY=[X,Y]$.
Proof

↗ prop:pet-ch2-lie-derivative-bracket

\sketch The defining expansion gives

\[ Y|_{F^t}-DF^t(Y)=t\, DF^t(L_XY)+o(t). \]

Applied to an arbitrary smooth function, its left side equals

\[ (D_Yf)\circ F^t-D_Y(f\circ F^t) =t(D_XD_Yf-D_YD_Xf)+o(t). \]

Comparison of the first-order terms yields $D_{L_XY}f=D_{[X,Y]}f$ for every $f$, hence $L_XY=[X,Y]$.

□
